post.caption:
Deep sea animals are not built to withstand pressure, they are built to equalise with it. No gas cavities, flexible bodies, stabilised proteins. That is why nothing happens to them at 1,000 atmospheres and everything happens on the way up. The famous blobfish photo is a decompressed fish, not an ugly one.
